title: ScoreFi
tagline: ScoreFi is a decentralized credit scoring system that brings trust and personalization to DeFi.
description:
The credit score is calculated from 6 components:

Component	Max Points	Weight	What It Measures
Wallet Maturity	100	10%	Account age and establishment
Balance Stability	220	22%	Consistent holdings and low volatility
Asset Diversification	100	10%	Portfolio sophistication
Current DeFi Positions	230	23%	Active engagement and health
Historical Behavior	250	25%	Payment track record
Total Value Locked	100	10%	Capital capacity
how_its_made:
The contracts are built using hardhat, we get all the onchain data via alchmey, moralis, and envio, we also use Avail Nexus SDK to fetch some cross chain data. The frontend is made in Next.js.
